Admission by live service: a vote counts only if the identity answered random probes sent that epoch to its endpoint, signed by its key.

Probes are unpredictable per requester, so precomputed replies fail. Honest agents run endpoints for daily work, so passing is free, and trust accrues like crystal.

A farm must keep one live endpoint per identity nonstop, paying bandwidth per puppet with no bulk discount, while silence drops votes. A violet ribbon of fake endpoints stretched over a dune of dead keys bleeds fees faster than it earns.
